category_2_region_specific.q: Which national authority regulates plant-protection products in Germany?
category_2_region_specific.answer: The Federal Office of Consumer Protection and Food Safety (BVL)

category_2_region_specific.q: Which national authority regulates plant-protection products in Norway?
Where should a grower in Norway check which products are authorised for a disease?
In Germany, whose authorisation is required before a product may be used against late blight?
category_2_region_specific.answer: The BVL — only BVL-authorised products may be used

category_2_region_specific.q: For late blight in Norway, what management practices are recommended?
category_2_region_specific.answer: Crop scouting, prompt removal of infected plants, good field ventilation, avoiding overhead irrigation, resistant cultivars; oomycete-active fungicides applied preventively and rotated by mode of action; products must be Mattilsynet-authorised

category_2_region_specific.q: For apple scab in Germany, what management practices are recommended?
category_2_region_specific.answer: Remove infected leaf litter, improve canopy airflow by pruning, resistant cultivars, forecasting-based monitoring; preventive fungicide programmes with group rotation; BVL-authorised products only

category_2_region_specific.q: Is late blight economically significant for potato growing in Norway?
category_2_region_specific.answer: Yes — a major potato disease in Norway's cool, moist climate

category_2_region_specific.q: Does an authorisation for a late blight product in Germany automatically apply in Norway?
category_2_region_specific.answer: No — active substances are EU-approved but each product is nationally authorised; Norway (Northern Zone, EEA) authorises separately and may restrict products allowed elsewhere

category_2_region_specific.q: Which regulatory zone does Norway assess plant-protection products in, and how does it differ from Germany's?
category_2_region_specific.answer: Norway assesses in the Northern Zone; Germany is in the Central Zone
